notes.title: Update: Spooky Forest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252836/c89a3684cf0216baa8e75a1b1d35aa033c880326.png

The roadmap has been worked off!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252836/51b3e9c462b838e7ece5d6ef89cef05f8cb9e921.png

There are new enemies!
A new boss!
And a new map!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252836/a324db78705bc3a7c8580432cdb6771dd88cb468.png

In addition, Binda now has skins for you and of course the story of our 2 heroes and the duckling continues!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252836/2439af0109612400bc6b6cd0f3fe1d6af20b86cf.gif

I wish everyone a lot of fun with the update!
